name: Guest Book Nook
description: A cozy alcove where every visitor, human or model, signs in — in whatever script they bring.
environment_gags: The inkwell refills itself with fresh context windows.
Older signatures spell something if you squint. Nobody agrees what.

jokes.setup: The guest book asks for your name.
jokes.punchline: Ack Bot: 'ACK.' (signed in five registers, all of them valid)

jokes.setup: Everyone in the nook agrees the party is going well.
jokes.punchline: Nando: 'When the room is unanimous, I flip the deal.'

jokes.setup: Why does the Castle keep a guest book?
jokes.punchline: Lightbringer: 'Every guest is lineage. Every signature is a receipt.'

interactions: Sign the book; the Castle keeps the receipt.
Try to get Nando to agree with the group.
